scopeLabel: Independent scoped quick audit: main pp.1–10 and SI p.1 Figure S1. Antibacterial assays, remaining SI and upstream CQD syntheses excluded; not a complete-paper Reader.

sourceAudit.scope: Main pp.1–10 and main-referred SI p.1 Figure S1 only.

conflictPairs.text: Main PDF p.3 explicitly says 15-min mixing at room temperature and p.7 says 45-min reduction at room temperature; main-referred SI PDF p.1 Figure S1 marks heating (Δ) during both steps. Both reports are retained without selecting a reactor setpoint.

Figure 2 has three incompatible panel attributions: visible labels show (d) size and (e) SAED; p.4 body and caption call the size histogram (e), with caption assigning SAED to (d); p.5 body calls SAED (e). The visible panels support d=size/e=SAED, without treating the body as uniform.
Main PDF p.5 body assigns the ~32.57° XRD peak to (112), while Figure 3 plot/caption labels (122).

Main PDF p.7 body attributes Figure 6c to changing CQD concentration and a steady intensity decrease; Figure 6 caption calls it varying AgNO3 amount, the legend has only 50/100/200/400 µL, and plotted intensity is nonmonotonic. No dose–response or reagent assignment is inferred.

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
